title: Password reset authentication failure
description: Users cannot log in after resetting their password.
resolution: Clear the stale session and retry authentication; reset the password again if required.

title: Database connection timeout
description: The application frequently times out while connecting to the database.
resolution: Check connection pool limits, database health, and network latency.

title: Email notifications delayed
description: Users are not receiving email notifications on time.
resolution: Inspect the outbound mail queue and notification worker status.

title: Application performance degradation
description: The application is responding slowly during peak usage.
resolution: Review CPU and memory utilization and identify slow requests.

title: Payment processing failure
resolution: Check payment gateway connectivity, credentials, and transaction logs.

title: Account sign-in credentials rejected
description: Valid users receive authentication errors when signing in.
resolution: Validate identity-provider configuration and refresh authentication tokens.

title: Slow database query performance
description: Database queries are taking longer than expected.
resolution: Review query plans, indexes, and database resource utilization.

title: Startup application crash
description: The application crashes immediately after startup.
resolution: Review startup logs and validate required configuration and dependencies.

title: Password reset link expired
description: Password reset links expire before users can complete the reset.
resolution: Review reset-token lifetime and clock synchronization.

title: Notification worker stopped
description: Email notifications stopped after a worker restart.
resolution: Restart the worker and inspect queue and service health.
